notes.title: Saves and new settings!
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to v1.22

Here are the patch notes!

-Added save and load slots! Save your game and pick it back up at another time! 
-Added options for different map sizes: small/medium/large 
-Added AI difficulty options: normal/unfair/very unfair 
-Added options for teams, play 2v1 against the AI if you'd like!

-Clandestine planet bombing damage has been significantly increased

-A player with the name "Server" in it will not spawn any enemy AI. 
This is so you can host a game intended for mobile and offload some of the server costs. Or if you just wanted to host a giant persistent game that players could drop in and out of.
